Terminal Bonus: A non-cumulative, non-guaranteed bonus, the amount of which is valid until the next declaration

keyFigures.value: Remainder of sum assured and bonuses

keyFigures.condition: On diagnosis of a covered condition

exclusionsOrConditions: Applies only to the TPD and Caring Benefit conditions, not to all illnesses.

The payments are advances, so the eventual death benefit is reduced.
The remaining balance is paid only if the diagnosed condition persists.
